title: AnyAEE7
tagline: Interact with any existing Dapp using your EIP 4337-compliant smart wallet
description: All the existing Dapps assume that the wallet connected to it is an EOA. Smart wallets usually require custom integration. With AnyEE7, smart wallet owners can use any Dapp to manipulate their assets in their smart wallet.
how_its_made:
- Bicnomony SDK was thorwing a BSA010 error. Biconomy mentors fixed this.
- I also wanted to support InstaDapp's DSA here but DSA does not allow arbitrary calls and that's why it is not supported.
